home.faq1Q: What exactly does an AI automation agency for startups do?
home.faq1A: Maleo AI helps startups and companies implement AI to improve efficiency, automate workflows, and support smarter business decisions. Beyond building software, we identify repetitive processes, operational bottlenecks, and growth opportunities where AI can create real business impact. This can include AI-powered internal tools, workflow automation, customer support AI agents, business intelligence & reporting systems, custom AI product development, and process optimization using automation.
home.faq2Q: How is Maleo AI different from a typical software development agency?
home.faq2A: We combine strategic thinking, execution, and access to specialized expertise. Maleo AI is backed by a curated network of 100+ senior technology experts across APAC and Europe, allowing us to activate the right specialists in AI, software engineering, cybersecurity, blockchain and emerging technologies based on each project's needs. With us, clients can move faster, access niche expertise on demand, and avoid unnecessary hiring overhead for highly specialized technical work.
home.faq3Q: Do you work with early-stage startups or only established companies?
home.faq3A: Yes. We work with early-stage startups, founders, and growing businesses, especially teams that need technical direction but don't want to waste time or budget building the wrong thing. Whether you're validating an idea, streamlining operations, or preparing to scale, we help turn ideas into practical systems.
home.faq4A: We work across industries where AI and automation can drive meaningful efficiency and smarter decision-making. This includes professional services, recruitment & HR, education, hospitality & tourism, e-commerce, real estate, financial services, and operations-heavy businesses. That said, we care more about the problem quality than the industry itself.
home.faq5A: We start with a discovery call to understand your business, goals, bottlenecks, and where AI can realistically create value. From there, we typically go through: 1) Discovery & Assessment - understand workflows, pain points, and opportunities. 2) Strategy & Solution Design - recommend the right AI systems, automation, or product roadmap. 3) Build & Implementation - develop and deploy the solution. 4) Optimization & Support - improve performance and ensure adoption.

aiTraining.heroTitle: AI Training & Workshop for Indonesian Businesses
aiTraining.subtitle: Your people don't need to understand complex algorithms. They need to know how AI solves your business problems, and that's exactly what we teach.
aiTraining.challengeTitle: Why Most Indonesian Businesses Struggle with AI
aiTraining.challengeIntro: Indonesian companies face a tough reality. While 53% of CEOs know AI is important, their teams lack the practical knowledge to use it safely and effectively.
aiTraining.challenge1Desc: 95% of mid-sized Indonesian businesses have fragmented systems that can't work together. Your data lives in different places. No one gets the complete picture.
aiTraining.challenge2Desc: 100% of Indonesian business leaders worry about AI-based fraud like deepfakes and fake documents, but most don't know how to protect against it.
aiTraining.challenge3Desc: When one person knows how the AI system works and they leave, everything falls apart. That knowledge walks out the door with them.
aiTraining.challenge4Desc: You buy AI tools. Your team never really uses them. Money spent, value never realized.
aiTraining.solutionTitle: Our Approach: Built for Indonesian Businesses
aiTraining.solutionDesc: We don't teach complex data science. We teach your team how to evaluate, deploy, and optimize AI solutions that actually solve your business problems.
aiTraining.workshopSubtitle: Learn AI in the Way That Actually Works
aiTraining.workshopDesc: Your team learns by doing, not by sitting through slides about algorithms. We use real business scenarios from Indonesian industries. Your team works with live AI tools and sees results immediately. No coding required.
aiTraining.workshopAudience: Department heads making technology decisions, operations managers who want to automate processes, finance teams analyzing business data, anyone implementing AI tools in your business.
aiTraining.workshopDuration: 2 to 3 days of intensive hands-on learning.
aiTraining.customDevSubtitle: Build Tools Your Business Actually Needs
aiTraining.customDevDesc: Sometimes you need a custom AI solution built specifically for how your business works. We build it and train your team to maintain it independently.
aiTraining.supportDesc: AI isn't a one-time project. It evolves and needs attention. We help you solve issues that emerge after launch, teach your team to optimize systems, and document every process.
aiTraining.differenceTitle: Why We're Different for Indonesian Businesses
aiTraining.difference1Desc: We provide training in Indonesian and English. Our examples come from Indonesian industries and challenges. We know the local business environment.
aiTraining.difference2Desc: No lectures about backpropagation or gradient descent. We start with business outcomes and show how AI helps.
aiTraining.difference3Desc: After we're done, your team maintains the systems independently. You reduce dependency on expensive external consultants.
aiTraining.benefits3MonthsDesc: Your team understands AI fundamentals and can evaluate solutions confidently. First AI tools are deployed without needing external help.
aiTraining.benefits6MonthsDesc: Custom AI solutions are built and owned by your team. You see measurable efficiency gains: faster processes, fewer errors.
aiTraining.benefitsBeyondDesc: AI becomes part of how you operate. You have competitive advantage through faster decision-making and a foundation for continued digital transformation.
aiTraining.caseStudy1Desc: Sales teams spend most of their time on research. We built and deployed a Lead Discovery App that automates prospect identification, handles data enrichment, and automated outreach. Sales teams fill pipelines faster and customer acquisition costs dropped.
aiTraining.caseStudy2Desc: Small business owners wanted to use AI but thought it was only for big tech companies. We ran a hands-on workshop showing practical, affordable AI tools. Workshop participants implemented 8 AI solutions within 30 days.
aiTraining.caseStudy3Desc: We introduced a different perspective: AI should not be seen merely as a tool, but as leverage. Founders began reframing how they think about AI, from 'How do I use AI?' to 'How do I build systems powered by AI?'
aiTraining.goodFitTitle: You're a Good Fit If You
aiTraining.goodFit1: Lead a business in Indonesia and want your team to understand and use AI
aiTraining.goodFit2: Need custom AI solutions with internal ownership
aiTraining.goodFit3: Are concerned about security and fraud with AI
aiTraining.goodFit4: Want to reduce dependency on expensive external experts
aiTraining.faq1Q: Does My Team Need to Know Programming?
aiTraining.faq1A: No. We focus on using AI tools and interpreting results, not coding. If your team can use Excel, they can learn this.
aiTraining.faq2A: A basic workshop is 2 to 3 days. Building custom solutions with full team training typically takes 2 to 4 months.
aiTraining.faq3Q: What If Something Goes Wrong After Training?
aiTraining.faq3A: We provide ongoing support. Plus, your team will be equipped to handle issues and know when to call us.
aiTraining.faq4Q: Is AI Training Really Worth the Cost?
aiTraining.faq4A: Yes. One automated process typically pays for training in 2 to 3 months. After that, it's pure savings.
